say.speaker: machop
say.text: See the glowing tiles at the eastern end of the cavern? That shaft opens straight onto the sunny slopes above the capital valley!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Wild cave Pokemon are riled up all around us, and more will chase us from the side stairs. Keep moving east and escort {lord} onto the exit tiles!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Got it! Push forward together and break through to the exit!
